meta.name: WeCrashed
meta.description:
Inspired by actual events—and the love story at the center of it all. WeWork grew from a single coworking space into a global brand worth $47 billion in under a decade. Then, in less than a year, its valuation dropped $40 billion. What happened?

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: This Is Where It Begins
videos.overview: Adam Neumann is a young entrepreneur finding his path in the business world when he meets Rebekah, who inspires him to launch a company.

videos.title: Masha Masha Masha
videos.overview: Tying the knot after a whirlwind romance, Adam and Rebekah begin their life together as he expands WeWork and she pursues acting.

videos.title: Summer Camp
videos.overview: The growing WeWork team gathers on Rebekah's family property. Rebekah grapples with a public relations misstep and bad personal news.
With Adam's fame growing and WeWork on the rise, Rebekah begins to feel sidelined at home and decides to pursue a new friendship.

videos.title: Hustle Harder
videos.overview: After a huge investment, WeWork is firmly in the big leagues—and Adam is ready to take aim at his competition. Rebekah's friendship is strained.

videos.title: Fortitude
videos.overview: Chaos at WeWork sends the Neumanns on a retreat to the west coast. Concerns grow about Adam's leadership. Rebekah finds a new focus.

videos.title: The Power of We
videos.overview: Rebekah is frustrated with WeGrow's progress while Adam attempts to mend their relationship. They state their mission—and the world reacts.

videos.title: The One with All the Money
videos.overview: After a disastrous reaction kills the IPO, Adam and Rebekah fight for their lives at WeWork. Adam risks it all in a last-ditch effort.
